edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of USD 4,800,000, payable in accordance with the parties’ agreed timing and mechanics.
edits.name: Payment provision

edits.text: 2. MUTUAL RELEASE. Upon payment, each party, on behalf of itself and its respective past and present affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns, releases and forever discharges the other party and its respective past and present affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, heirs, executors, administrators, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, causes of action, damages, and liabilities of every kind, whether known or unknown, suspected or unsuspected, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this dispute. The foregoing release does not apply to rights or obligations created by this Agreement or to claims that cannot be waived as a matter of law. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits either party from making disclosures required by law, tax authorities, or court order, or from consulting with its attorneys, accountants, tax advisors, or other professional advisors, provided that any such disclosure is limited to what is reasonably necessary and, where legally permitted, the disclosing party gives prompt notice to the other party.
edits.name: Mutual release with carve-outs

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, subject to the disclosures permitted under Section 2.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
edits.name: No admission
